CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RATNAKER BHENGRA -------
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Rahul Ranjan, Advocate

For the State : Mr. S.K. Tiwari, A.P.P.
 --------
th Order No.9/Dated: 19 September, 2023
When the matter is called out, both the learned counsels have appeared.
The learned counsel for the State has filed counter-affidavit in the Court today.
Taken on record.
Petitioner is an accused for the offence registered under section 419/420/467/468/471/120(B) IPC and under sections 66(B), 66(C ), 66(D) and 84(C ) of the IT Act.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on the basis of secret information two persons were apprehended.

He further submits that it is alleged that police has raided the house of the petitioner and from his house as well as from his pocket two mobile sets, three ATM cards, one passbook and one checkbook were recovered.
He further submits that however there is no compliant against the petitioner.

He further submits that in counter-affidavit at paragraph no.4 it is stated that some persons were cheated but the said cheating was done from the mobile phone of another co-accused and not from the mobile phone of this petitioner.
He further submits that petitioner has one criminal antecedent prior to the present case in Telangana.
He also submits that the petitioner has one Cyber Case No. 229 of 21 in Kolkatta in which compromise has taken place.
The petitioner is in custody since 28.2.2023.
Therefore, he may be released on bail.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that it is clear that there are two other criminal antecedents against the petitioner and further as per Annexure-A to the counter-affidavit filed by him there are seventy cases against the petitioner which shows that the petitioner is a habitual criminal.

Having heard learned counsels for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, I am not inclined to release the petitioner on bail and, hence, his prayer for bail stands rejected at this stage.
KNR (Ratnaker Bhengra, J.)
